text:
Welcome to Tran Quoc Pagoda, or Chùa Trấn Quốc, one of the oldest Buddhist pagodas located beside the serene West Lake. This beautiful site is renowned for its impressive tall stupa and tranquil waterside courtyards, making it a must-visit destination for both tourists and locals alike.

The pagoda is open for visitors from 7:30 AM to 6:30 PM. Please note that it is advisable to dress modestly while visiting, as this is an active place of worship. Admission is completely free, allowing everyone to enjoy the spiritual atmosphere and stunning surroundings without any cost.

As you explore, take a moment to appreciate the intricate architecture and peaceful ambiance that have made this site a beloved landmark. Don't forget to capture some photos of the picturesque views of West Lake from the pagoda grounds.

Enjoy your visit to Tran Quoc Pagoda and immerse yourself in the rich culture and tradition that this historic site represents!
